text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with an update on the terms of reference for the Environmental, Social and Governance Committee.

The Environmental, Social and Governance Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the terms of reference for the Environmental, Social and Governance Committee, as noted in Attachment 1 to the report (April 12, 2021) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live.
